sections.summary: Configure the local development environment with Go tooling, linters, and pre-push hooks.
sections.context: The project uses Go with Cobra CLI, golangci-lint v2.1.6 via go run, and a Makefile-driven workflow. The pre-push hook in scripts/pre-push mirrors CI checks. New contributors need a one-command setup path.
acceptance_criteria: Running `make setup` installs git hooks and verifies Go toolchain
Pre-push hook runs go build, go test, golangci-lint, and markdownlint

issues.title: Write initial unit test suite for forge interface

sections.summary: Create table-driven unit tests covering the IssueTracker interface methods.
sections.context: The IssueTracker interface is defined in internal/forge/forge.go with 12 methods. The GitHub adapter in internal/forge/github/github.go has 14 existing tests. New tests should cover edge cases: rate limiting, pagination, optimistic locking races, and error wrapping.
acceptance_criteria: Table-driven tests for all 12 IssueTracker methods
Edge case coverage for rate limiting and pagination
Optimistic locking race condition test with concurrent claims

sections.summary: Determine Gitea's webhook retry behavior and delivery guarantees for issue events.
sections.context: The dispatcher agent relies on webhook events to wake when new issues are created. If Gitea drops webhook deliveries silently, the dispatcher needs a polling fallback. GitHub webhooks have documented retry behavior (re-delivery on 5xx). Gitea's guarantees are less clear from the official docs.
acceptance_criteria: Document Gitea webhook retry policy (count, interval, timeout)
Identify failure modes where webhooks are silently dropped
Recommend whether a polling fallback is needed alongside webhooks
